Definition: GA initialization is disabled and the pheromone matrix is initialized uniformly at tauMin.
Entropy-triggered switching is replaced by a fixed switch at the scale-specific center iteration: 60 for ulysses22 and st70, and 105 for kroC100 and kroA150.
Rank-based reinforcement is disabled and the top 20% of tours deposit pheromone equally with weight 1/L.
Entropy-based 3-opt adaptation is disabled and threeOptMaxIter is fixed at 80.

scaleAwareEnabled and segmentParametersEnabled are set to false. The instance-specific base configurations are retained without the scale-profile and segment-override layers; exact values and configuration hashes are reported in Table S14a and protocols/configs/.
